title: Why Families, Retirees & Remote Workers Love Boone NC
excerpt: Boone, NC has quietly become one of the most sought-after places to live in the Southeast — and it's not hard to understand why. From its four-season lifestyle and tight-knit community to its strong real estate fundamentals, the High Country checks a lot of boxes for a lot of different people.
